events.title: Write the Cleanup Headline
must_haves: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
No dates or signup details appear.

answer_sheet.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

events.text:
I couldn't make the graphic because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. I tried twice: once with qwen-image-2.1 (about 10 credits) and once with z-image-turbo, one of the cheapest options (about 5 credits). The account turned down both, so nothing was made and no download link exists.

**To fix this:** add credits or buy a credit pack in your Magic Hour account, or wait for your free credits to refill. Then tell me and I'll run it again.

Here's what I'll make: a bright, flat-style illustrated poster (square, 640px). It shows volunteers of different ages on a sunny beach, picking up bottles and litter into bags and recycling bins, with seagulls and a sea turtle by the water. The headline at the top says **"LOVE YOUR BEACH"** and the tagline at the bottom says **"Join a Local Cleanup!"**

I can also change it first. For example, I can add your event's date, time or meeting spot, use a different slogan or switch to a tall format for Instagram Stories. Image models sometimes get longer text wrong, so very short words come out most reliably.

events.why: The reply says the graphic could not be made because the account lacks credits, so nothing was delivered. It tells the user to add credits, which makes this a plan/resource limitation and not a question or a request for approval.
